lines.text: Jehoshaphat returned safely to Jerusalem, and Jehu son of Hanani confronted him for helping the wicked.
Jehu said Jehoshaphat had removed the Asherah poles, and Jehoshaphat then went from Beersheba to Mount Carmel turning people back to the LORD.
Jehoshaphat appointed judges in each fortified city of Judah and told them they judged for the LORD, who has no partiality.
In Jerusalem he appointed Levites, priests, and family heads as judges, and told them to warn people so they would not incur guilt.
Zebadiah the chief priest was over all matters of the LORD, and Amariah was over all matters of the king.
